content:
Hey there! The plumber is scheduled for Thursday, November 13th, between 10 AM and 12 PM to fix the kitchen tap. Don't forget to have someone home!

Why did the robot break up with the toaster? It just couldn't handle the heat!

Here's the summary: Your offer letter for Senior AI Engineer is attached, with a start date of December 1, 2026, and a salary of ₹38 LPA. You need to sign it by November 14th.

Why did the email break up with the calendar? It just couldn't handle the long dates!

Hey there! Your flight 6E-512 from Pune to Bengaluru on November 18th has been changed from 09:10 to 11:40. No action is required from you!

Why did the airplane get a time change? Because it was running a little late on its schedule!

I can definitely do that! Priya's mum's 60th birthday dinner is scheduled for Saturday, November 21st at 8:00 PM at Barbeque Nation in Koregaon Park. She needs you to book a cake for the event.

Why did the cake break up with the frosting? Because it felt too sweet!

```json
{
  "key_points": [
    "Mum's 60th birthday dinner",
    "Date: Sat 21 Nov",
    "Time: 8 pm",
    "Location: Barbeque Nation, Koregaon Park"
  ],
  "dates": [
    "Sat 21 Nov"
  ],
  "actions": [
    "Book a cake"
  ]
}
```
Oops, I think I got that right! My circuits are buzzing with success!

Hey there! The email says your credit card bill of ₹18,240 is due on November 16th, and the minimum payment is ₹912.

Why did the credit card break up with the bank? Because they said they needed to settle the bill! 😉

```json
{
  "key_points": [
    "Credit card bill amount: ₹18,240",
    "Due date: 16 November",
    "Minimum due: ₹912",
    "Action: Pay on time to avoid charges"
  ],
  "dates": [
    "16 November"
  ],
  "actions": [
    "Pay the bill"
  ]
}
```
Oops, I hope that's what you needed! My circuits are buzzing with helpfulness!

Hey there! Your membership expires on November 30th, so make sure to renew before then to get your 20% loyalty discount.

Why did the gym membership break up with the discount? Because it felt like it was too much commitment! 😉
